queue_shard_count.description: The number of parallel queues that a collection queue can be sharded.

queue_shard_limit.description: For bulk processing queues: the batch size or number of queued items to process at a time.

chunk_strategy.description: The chunking strategy used by the elasticsearch-indexer (e.g. 'code_bytes')

chunk_strategy_size.description: The chunk size parameter for the chunking strategy
